title: Thanks to Siri Recaps, your Apple Watch is always listening
summary: Apple Watch's Siri Recaps feature uses continuous audio listening to generate AI-powered daily summaries for users, raising significant privacy concerns similar to the backlash Meta faced with their smart glasses that recorded bystanders without consent.
problem_solved: Provides hands-free, context-aware daily activity summaries without manual input by continuously analyzing user interactions throughout the day.
why_valuable: Offers unprecedented convenience by automatically capturing and summarizing daily moments, but at the cost of constant audio surveillance that could infringe on bystander privacy rights.
